title: Small files and output layout
summary: Output file count is part of pipeline design because it affects downstream listing, scan and metadata overhead.

blocks.text: Output file count is part of pipeline design because it affects downstream listing, scan and metadata overhead.

items: One file per tiny partition creates small-file overhead.
Do not coalesce to one file for large production data just for convenience.
Choose partition columns with query patterns and cardinality in mind.
Compaction/optimization should preserve correctness while improving file layout.

blocks.question: What is wrong with always coalescing to one output file?
blocks.answer: It destroys parallelism, can create a single-task bottleneck, and does not scale with large datasets.
